meta.title: Vietnam Travel Vlog | 10 Days in Vietnam: Hanoi, Da Nang & Ho Chi Minh | Malayalam
meta.description:
Hi Berrymelons! 🍓💕

I know it’s been a while since I uploaded. Life has been a little too dull lately to give you guys any content lol. 😭

ANYWAYS… in this video, my friends Anokha, Fathima and I - together known as SAF (yes, we coined the term after hallucinating from exhaustion after one too many long trip days 😂) - packed our bags, said toodles to work for 10 days, and flew off to Vietnam! ✈️

We travelled through Hanoi, Da Nang and Ho Chi Minh City, woke up at 6 AM, came back exhausted at midnight, ate A LOT, walked A LOT, somehow followed our ridiculously packed itinerary, and made approximately 847 memories along the way. 😂

This video is basically a compilation of all the chaos, fun, food, sightseeing and questionable decisions from our 10-day Vietnam trip.

A more detailed breakdown of our Vietnam itinerary, places we visited, hotels, flights, expenses and everything we did will be posted separatelyyy, so stay tuned! 👀

Thanks for watching and supporting my little corner of the internet. ❤️

Subscribe if you still want me to host that 1000 subscriber party, I keep threatening you guys with. 😂

Until next time,
SAF signing off from Vietnam🍓

Thank you to all 468 of you who’ve subscribed ❤️ You guys are the best!
